items.title: Set the object storage for backups
items.effect: Without object storage, the panel makes no backups. A scheduled backup and a manual backup fail, and you cannot restore a website.

items.title: Turn on two-step sign-in for each administrator
items.effect: Without two-step sign-in, a person who learns the password of an administrator controls the panel and all its servers.
items.detail: These administrators do not use two-step sign-in: Alex Admin (admin@example.com), Priya Operations (operations@example.com).

items.title: Turn on disk limits on each server
items.effect: Without project quotas on the file system, a server does not apply the disk limit of a plan. One website can fill the disk, and then all websites on that server stop.
items.detail: These servers do not apply disk limits: web-1. Mount /srv/cloudfactory on XFS or ext4 with project quotas (prjquota), then restart the agent.

items.title: Use a certificate that browsers trust for the panel
items.effect: The panel CA signs the certificate of a new panel. Browsers do not trust the panel CA, so each person who opens the panel sees a security warning.
items.detail: The panel CA signs the certificate of panel.cloudfactory.io. Change to Let's Encrypt, or add the root certificate of the panel CA to each browser.
